purpose: Record exact-byte browser and visual review of a static web output at its required responsive widths.
rules: The entry and all declared source files are hash-pinned to the receipt directory.
Each required width has one exact-byte PNG screenshot and all seven check results.
A passed receipt has no blocking findings and no failed check; reflow, computed fonts and contrast must be passed.
A pinned family visual reference and at least one signature feature must be reviewed; a passed review cannot leave a feature missing.
The entry hash must equal the output hash used by the portfolio coverage record.
This validator checks the evidence record, not whether a browser action was honestly performed.
